tool.name: Read Conversation Messages
tool.description: Fetch recent messages from a Starships conversation (default: 10 messages, latest-first).

offset.description: Tail offset (skip N most recent messages; default 0)

beforeId.description: Keyset cursor id (must be provided with beforeCreatedAt)

conversationId.description: Conversation id (optional; defaults to runtime CONVERSATION_ID)

orderDirection.description: Order direction: desc (latest-first) or asc (oldest-first). Default desc.

beforeCreatedAt.description: Keyset cursor timestamp ISO (must be provided with beforeId)
